title: SignalX Zero design-system manifest — lynx target envelope
description: The manifest the lynx target ships as dist/lynx/manifest.json (written by @sigx/zero-kit's writeLynxArtifacts): the SAME content as dist/manifest.json — one design system, one truth about its themes, token vocabulary and wired axes — under an envelope that says how this copy is delivered: target 'lynx', the class-grammar version the emitted selectors speak (a runtime refuses CSS from a grammar it does not know), and the capability-finding counts (the findings themselves live in report.json under 'lynx'). Everything except the envelope is derived mechanically from ds-manifest.schema.json; the schemas test pins the derivation.

$schema.description: Self-reference to this schema — the emitter always writes exactly this URL.

manifestVersion.description: The version of THIS FILE's shape. Bumped when the manifest contract changes incompatibly; consumers hard-check it rather than sniffing keys.

zeroVersion.description: The @sigx/zero contract version the design system was compiled against (lockstep with @sigx/zero-kit).

name.description: The design system's own name, as declared to defineDesignSystem.

themes.description: The compiled themes — names, color-scheme, light/dark pairing and the swatch a picker samples.

tokens.description: The DECLARED token vocabulary — what the design system says, as opposed to components[*], which is what its recipes deliver.

roles.description: Color roles: role name → declaration ({} = full role with -content and -soft). Doubles as the `color` axis vocabulary; empty for a design system with no colour axis.

sizes.description: The `size` axis ramp, resolved (declared, else the recommended ramp); [] when declared out of existence.

variants.description: The `variant` axis vocabulary — the UNION of every scope's vocabulary once tokens.scopes restricts any ([] when undeclared or declared out of existence — `variantsDeclared` tells the two apart).

variantsDeclared.description: Whether `tokens.variants` was stated at all. `variants: []` is the claim "this design system has no variant axis" (the grammar `sizes: []` uses); an omitted key is only silence, and both resolve to an empty `variants` list.

axes.description: Declared custom variant axes: axis name → values.

scopes.description: Per-scope restrictions of the vocabularies above (#294; docs/architecture.md, "Declared vocabulary") — scope → its own vocabulary subset. {} when none are declared.

custom.description: Free-form custom token declarations, as authored.

system.description: DS-level values per token category id (radius, size, typography, …), as authored.

properties.description: Every custom property the compiled tokens.css emits, flat and sorted.

components.description: Scope → the axis vocabulary that scope's recipe actually WIRES (plus, when tokens.scopes restricts it, what the scope offers). A scope absent here has no recipe in this design system.

api.description: Scope → the vendor-named API surface — present iff the design system declares an `api` (issue #179).

externalScopes.description: Scope → the ecosystem package that ships it, for every component adopted from outside @sigx/zero. Absent when the design system adopted none. A top-level key rather than a field on componentAxes, which holds what a recipe WIRES — an owning package is not an axis fact.

target.description: The emit target this copy was compiled for.

classGrammarVersion.description: The class grammar version the emitted selectors speak (zx-<scope>__<part> et al). A runtime checks it before trusting the stylesheet.

capabilities.description: Counts of capability findings — what the lynx emitters translated or dropped. The findings themselves live in report.json under 'lynx'.

axisValue.description: An axis VALUE: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, repeated hyphens included (Carbon's danger--tertiary) — what a quoted [data-…="…"] attribute selector, a single-quoted literal union in register.d.ts and an unescaped lynx class name (zx-a-<axis>-<value>) all carry verbatim. Wider than the kebab-case grammar names take; still no %, ., quotes, backslashes, whitespace or uppercase.

kebabToken.description: A kebab-case identifier that may start with a digit — the grammar for token keys and axis/modifier names.

pair.description: The counterpart theme toggle() switches to.

swatch.description: Representative colors for pickers: token → CSS color.

axisValues.description: A wired value set. Modifier names ride the same list shape; their kebab grammar is a subset of the axis-value one.

axes.description: Custom axes this recipe wires: axis name → values.

defaults.description: The recipe's defaultVariants — manifest/docs only, never widens a union.

offered.description: The vocabulary this scope OFFERS (its tokens.scopes entry, resolved) — the promise, where the sibling fields are the delivery.
